px_w.source: 2048 px by 1536 px multispectral, Freefly docs page

px_h.source: 2048 px by 1536 px multispectral, Freefly docs page

fov_h_deg.source: 47 deg HFOV (MSP and RGB), Freefly docs page and reseller listing

fov_v_deg.source: derived from the published 47 deg HFOV and the 4:3 pixel grid; not published

pixel_pitch_um.source: not found; 3.45 um assumed for a 3.2 MP global-shutter mono sensor. Footprint uses the published FOV, so this only sets the derived focal length

focal_mm.source: unused: derived from the published HFOV

shutter_min_s.source: global shutter, fastest exposure not found; stand-in

exposure_s.source: typical daylight exposure for the blur check (1/2000 s); editable

trigger_min_interval_s.source: sustained capture rate 5 fps (reseller listing); 0.2 s between captures
